visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, e.g. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(232,210,166,0.1)] on active hover states. Otherwise flat.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626 on surfaces, changing to #E8D2A6/30 on hover for interactive cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/60 border-b border-white/5 for the sticky header. Must look like premium milled crystal.
visual_enhancers.texture: Optional 2% noise overlay on the main background to break digital flatness.

grids_layouts.hero: Full-width layout with an 80vh max-height hero image, text aligned to the left, bottom-aligned with a gradient overlay bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/60 to-transparent. Never purely black overlay.
grids_layouts.media_carousel: Horizontal scrolling (overflow-x-auto snap-x) with gap-4 or gap-6. Hide scrollbars.
grids_layouts.media_grid: CSS Grid: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-6. Items are posters with aspect-[2/3].
grids_layouts.bento_dashboard: Admin panel uses a high-density bento grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Strict hierarchy.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Primary buttons use bg-[#E8D2A6] text-black font-semibold hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Secondary buttons use transparent bg with border border-[#262626] text-white hover:border-[#E8D2A6]/50.
components.cards: Cardless approach for media items. Just the image poster with rounded-lg overflow-hidden and text below. Admin dashboard uses flat rectangular cards with 1px border border-[#262626] and no shadow.
components.navigation: Sticky top header. Navigation links must be visible on desktop. Logo (YourMovie's) on left, links center, Auth/Profile on right.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized: bg-[#111111] border-[#262626] focus:border-[#E8D2A6] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E8D2A6]/50 rounded-md text-white.

motion.hover: Movie posters slightly scale up (scale-105) on hover with a 0.4s ease-out transition. Images must not break border-radius on scale.
motion.page_transition: Framer motion for subtle fade-in and slide-up on route changes.
motion.image_load: Fade in images using opacity transition to prevent pop-in.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets APCA contrast standards against #050505. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for text-bearing elements.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons (like play, favorite, watchlist).

media.posters: Maintain 2:3 aspect ratio for all movie/anime/series posters using aspect-[2/3] object-cover.
media.banners: Maintain 16:9 or full-viewport width aspect ratio for hero banners and trailers.

hero_banners.description: Misty mountains for fantasy/anime hero section
Tokyo aerial view for urban anime/sci-fi hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: App name is 'YourMovie\'s'. Implement this in the branding.
Implement lucide-react for all icons, keeping a minimal and sharp icon style.
DO NOT use generic colors like tailwind's blue-500. Strictly use the defined Pale Gold (#E8D2A6) and dark surface shades (#111111).
DO NOT use Inter for headings. Use 'Outfit' from Google Fonts. Body text should be 'Manrope'.
Implement Framer Motion for micro-interactions (hover, layout changes, page transitions).
Hero sections MUST have a bottom-to-top gradient overlay (max 60% opacity) for text legibility. Never full black overlays.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
Use standard HTML5 video element for local mp4 playback, styled with Tailwind for a custom cinematic player look. Embed YouTube trailers via iframe.
Admin panel should use Shadcn UI heavily customized to fit the dark aesthetic (remove default shadows, 1px subtle borders, dark backgrounds).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and overlays.
NEVER use universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
DO NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, etc.) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. DO NOT use placeholder text or dummy image services. If missing, use flat colored divs with category icons.
3d_libraries: Framer Motion for 2D layout animations and micro-interactions. No heavy 3D library required for this context, to keep the streaming performance optimal and clean.
